Maya (AE): Tess says their POC frontend crashes on some streamed messages with `Unexpected token \u0000`. Happens only on longer responses.
Tess (Client): repro: open SSE, after 4-5 events one event causes JSON.parse to throw; browser console shows NUL bytes in stream. No backend 500s.
Omar (SE): can you run `curl -N` against the SSE URL and paste a hexdump (`xxd`) around the failing region? Need to confirm 00 bytes.
Tess (Client): hexdump snippet: `... 7d 0a 0a 64 61 74 61 3a 20 7b 22id":"x"...7d 00 0a 0a` — there is a 00 right after the JSON end.
Ravi (Oncall): NULs are often added by a proxy buffer padding or by an app server writing fixed-size blocks. Are you fronted by nginx or a CDN?
Tess (Client): nginx + Fastly.
Hannah (Eng): on Redwood we've hit this: proxies sometimes re-chunk and pad when upstream uses buffered writes. For SSE ensure chunked transfer with no Content-Length and disable proxy buffering on the route.
Omar (SE): quick fixes to try in nginx location: `proxy_buffering off; proxy_request_buffering off; gzip off; proxy_http_version 1.1; chunked_transfer_encoding on;` and set `sendfile off;` for dynamic streams. Also check Fastly settings to avoid response normalization.
Tess (Client): applied `proxy_buffering off` and redeployed. curl -N looks clean now — no 00 bytes. Browser still had one error but far less.
Hannah (Eng): client hardening: accumulate until `\n\n` seen before JSON.parse. Example pattern: `let buf=''; res.on('data',c=>{buf+=c; while(buf.indexOf('\n\n')>-1){const p=buf.slice(0,buf.indexOf('\n\n')); buf=buf.slice(buf.indexOf('\n\n')+2); const payload=p.split('\n').filter(l=>l.startsWith('data:')).map(l=>l.replace(/^data:\s*/,'')).join('\n'); const clean=payload.replace(/\u0000/g,''); try{JSON.parse(clean)}catch(e){console.warn('parse',e)} }})`
infra-bot: Deployed `poc/streaming-proxy-fix` to staging (build #812).
Lina (Presales): ok to toggle tenant runtime flag `sse_strict=true` for this POC?
Hannah (Eng): yes low risk, will log occurrences. Lina please note in POC docs.
Tess (Client): after nginx change + client buffering it's stable for 12+ hours. thanks.
Maya (AE): action items: 1) Ravi/Hannah write short ops doc for SSE nginx + CDN guidance, 2) Omar/Lina add POC note about runtime flag and client workaround and close ticket when done.
Ravi (Oncall): will also scan edge proxies for similar NUL padding and open tickets if found.
Maya (AE): great teamwork :tada:
